backtest.note: Current V3 entry rules with complete aggregated bars. Decisions at M5 close; wait up to 30 minutes for a valid full M5 open inside the frozen zone; TP2 exit; SL first on ambiguous bars; max 72 bars. One alert per directional setup cycle; two closed M5 bars without setup or a direction change rearm alerts. Target path tracked separately after TP2; not additional paper wins. Historical replay is not exact wall-clock live execution.

execution_timing.assumption: Decision at M5 close; simulated alert after configured delay; first full M5 open at/after alert. 1 second models exclusion of the in-progress alert candle, not measured broker latency.

limitations: Broker spread/slippage/commission not configured; results are gross.
Provider schedule fetched after the fact; historical revisions and missing provider events cannot be reconstructed.

forward_test.execution: New paper trades wait up to 30 minutes after alert for a full M5 open inside the frozen zone with risk 20–80 pips and RR TP2 >= 2. Wick-only touches are not fills. Pre-fill SL/TP2 touches invalidate the plan. TP2 exit. Earlier models keep original rules.
